headline: MiniMax M3.1 Flash launches with reported agent benchmarks and lower token prices
summary: MiniMax announced M3.1 Flash on October 19 with vendor-reported agent, coding, computer-use and cybersecurity results. Its API is available through MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code; weights are forthcoming. MiniMax claims nearly 3x faster online inference and 70% lower agent-task usage cost than its predecessor, without a matched serving protocol. The current official pricing table lists M3.1 Flash at $0.15/$0.60 per million input/output tokens versus $0.30/$1.20 for M3 at contexts up to 512K, a nominal posted-rate comparison that does not establish realized task cost or historical price timing.
